scraped.scraped_description: Wikidata is a free and open knowledge base that can be read and edited by both humans and machines.

name: Wikidata
tagline: A free and open knowledge base that can be read and edited by both machines and humans
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
news_articles: Wikidata: Building a Better Wikipedia - The Guardian (2020)
How Wikidata is Changing Knowledge Management - TechCrunch (2021)
Wikidata Reaches 100 Million Items Milestone - Reuters (2022)
academic_citations: Vrandečić, D., & Krötzsch, M. (2014). Wikidata: A free and open knowledge base that can be read and edited by both machines and humans. IJSWIS, 10(4), 1-22.

awards: Recognition as critical infrastructure for knowledge sharing
policy_outcomes: Data shown in 64% of all Wikipedia pages; used by Apple Siri and Amazon Alexa
Recognised as a digital public good in 2025
published_performance_metrics: Data quality assessments published in academic literature; coverage statistics available on Wikidata website
documented_limitations: Data quality varies by language and topic
curation_criteria: Community-driven editorial standards; structured data validation; community consensus for major changes; documented contribution guidelines on GitHub and Wikidata project pages
contributor_governance: Community-driven with volunteer editors and administrators
disparity_tracking: Documented awareness of coverage gaps in non-Western topics and languages; ongoing initiatives to improve Global South representation
controversies: Debates over data accuracy and vandalism prevention
Discussions about representation of sensitive topics
Concerns about coverage bias toward Western knowledge systems
political_bias_allegations: Documented concerns about Western-centric bias in data coverage; ongoing community discussions about neutrality in structured data representation
legal_regulatory_issues: Subject to copyright and data protection regulations across jurisdictions; GDPR compliance considerations for personal data
government_partnerships: Various government agencies use Wikidata for open data initiatives
ai_involvement: Used as training data and knowledge source for AI/machine learning systems; integrated with natural language processing and knowledge graph applications
